import.title: Read ferry ticket
import.hint: Read a text PDF, email (.eml) or pasted ticket text. Unfamiliar layouts use the configured AI parser. Review suggestions before applying them.
import.retained: The file is in your unfiled documents. Saving attaches it to this crossing.
import.error: Could not read the ticket. You can still enter the crossing manually.
import.partial: Only some fields were found. AI was unavailable or not enabled.
import.noText: No readable text found. For a scanned ticket, paste its text or enter the details manually.
import.nothingFound: No supported values found. Please enter the details manually.
import.oneCrossing: One crossing is created per import. The original is attached only to that crossing.
import.review: Check values and supporting text. Fields you already filled are not preselected.
import.checkPorts: Values applied. Confirm both ports on the map or through port search and review all details.

live.title: Current vessel position
live.hint: Current AIS report for the MMSI you enter. This is not a historical track; it does not change the timetable or crossing.
live.notConfigured: Live vessel positions have not been configured on this instance yet.
live.noSignal: No matching AIS report arrived during this request. This does not mean the vessel is not sailing.
live.unavailable: The position service is currently unavailable.
live.busy: The position service is handling other requests. Please try again later.
live.ageUnknown: The source provides no complete observation timestamp. The age of this position is unknown.
